candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether proxy participation weakness or recovery persisted, rather than relying on isolated breadth captures with changing constituent membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: W41 review says quantitative breadth sequences are absent; daily outputs repeatedly report point-in-time top-100 breadth with differing membership hashes and no canonical-compatible history.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Timestamped advancer/decliner counts and return summaries for a consistently defined universe are not supplied as a comparable historical sequence; changing-membership snapshots cannot establish persistence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish persistent spot participation or liquidity deterioration from brief, potentially conflicting snapshots and overlapping price-move proxies.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs describe brief spot taker/depth snapshots, note disabled spot owners in some captures, and repeatedly state that persistence and temporal ordering are unknown.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped spot taker-flow and depth-imbalance observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: Comparable, timestamp-aligned spot measurements by asset and venue are not provided over prior days or weeks; isolated snapshots cannot establish whether microstructure changes preceded or followed price weakness.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether reported positive or negative ETF flows persisted and how their timing related to price, breadth, and relative-performance changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews cite W40 aggregate ETF units, while daily outputs often have only one settled session and identify stale sessions or missing intervening observations.
candidates.metric_name: Per-session settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: A continuous, timestamped settled-session history is not supplied across the reviewed periods; isolated sessions and weekly totals do not resolve within-period direction or persistence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit ex-ante versus ex-post review of the reported range candidates and retrospective hypotheses without reconstructing what was known from completed paths.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report missing candidate bounds, issue times, and point-in-time feature snapshots; daily outputs include candidates but the reviews lack a consistent frozen history and eligible typed warning outcomes.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped frozen analysis candidates and contemporaneous evidence snapshots
candidates.missing_history_problem: The historical record does not consistently preserve candidate specifications, issuance cutoffs, and the input observations available at those cutoffs, preventing direct audit of hindsight leakage, sequence, and subsequent outcomes.
